Help/Fixing a capture/Too large for a phone

The walkthrough is too large for a phone

The finished walkthrough would be too large to open smoothly on a phone. Veylet has already tried once more automatically. Capture fewer rooms in one walkthrough.

  1. Split the home into two captures, for example the living areas and the bedrooms.
  2. Capture each group of rooms as its own capture, with its own name.
  3. Send each one. Each becomes its own walkthrough, small enough for a phone.

If it doesn’t work

Very large open-plan spaces count as big too. Keep to two standing spots and three circles in each.

Recapturing won’t use a walkthrough.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
